sections.label: E
sections.title: Look and complete the sentences. Use the simple past.
sections.note: Write the simple past verb that matches each picture.

questions.explanation: The picture shows birds flying away. The simple past of fly is flew.
The picture shows the children eating cupcakes. The simple past of eat is ate.
The picture shows him at the library. The simple past of go is went.
The picture shows her drinking water. The simple past of drink is drank.

sections.label: F
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences. Then match them to the pictures.
sections.note: Each number has two answers: the complete sentence and picture a or b.

parts.label: Complete sentence
parts.explanation: Put the subject first, then the past verb and the rest of the sentence: I ate pasta for dinner.

parts.label: Matching picture
parts.explanation: Picture b shows a girl eating pasta.

questions.prompt: 2. eat / I / dinner / for / pasta / didn't

parts.label: Complete sentence
answers: I didn't eat pasta for dinner.
I didn't eat pasta for dinner
I did not eat pasta for dinner.
I did not eat pasta for dinner
parts.explanation: A negative simple past sentence uses didn't + the base verb eat: I didn't eat pasta for dinner.

parts.label: Matching picture
parts.explanation: Picture a shows a boy eating a different meal, not pasta.

sections.label: J
sections.title: Circle the correct words.
sections.note: Choose the word that makes each question or sentence correct.

questions.prompt: 1. Did you buy / bought a new jacket?
questions.explanation: After Did, use the base form buy.

questions.prompt: 2. The dog steal / stole a hamburger.
questions.explanation: The sentence describes a completed past action, so use stole.
What asks about the action: What did you do?
Where asks about a place: Where did you go?

questions.prompt: 5. I make / made a sandwich yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday shows a past action, so use made.

sections.label: K

questions.explanation: The picture shows a park, so the complete answer is: They went to the park.

questions.prompt: 2. How many cupcakes did he eat?
questions.explanation: The picture shows two cupcake wrappers and the cupcake he is eating. The answer key gives: He ate two cupcakes.

sections.label: L
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make questions. Look at the pictures and answer the questions.
sections.note: Each number has two answers: the complete question and the complete answer.

parts.label: Complete question
parts.explanation: Use What + did + subject + base verb: What did you do?

parts.label: Complete answer
parts.explanation: The picture shows the speaker drinking water, so answer: I drank some water.

questions.prompt: 2. go / Did / to / the play / they

parts.label: Complete question
answers: Did they go to the play?
Did they go to the play
parts.explanation: A simple past yes/no question uses Did + subject + base verb: Did they go to the play?

parts.label: Complete answer
parts.explanation: The picture does not show a play, so the answer is: No, they didn't.

parts.label: Complete question
parts.explanation: Put the words in question order: Did + she + have + three balloons?
